zh: 结果 y 能由原串 x 得到，当且仅当 x 的每个 1 位在 y 中也是 1，即 x 是 y 的子掩码。所以问题变成：有多少个 n 位掩码至少包含一个给定掩码作为子集。
n≤20，所有掩码只有 2ⁿ 个，可以对每个掩码记一个布尔标记，用“子集到超集”的逐位传播（SOS）把标记推到所有超集上，重复的输入自然合并。
开一个长度 2ⁿ 的布尔数组，把每个输入值标记为可达；对每一位 step=1,2,4,…，遍历每个块，若低半区的 low 可达，则标记 low+step 可达。全部位处理完后，统计被标记的掩码个数即为答案，不取模。
en: A result y can be produced from an original string x exactly when every 1 bit of x is also 1 in y, that is, x is a submask of y. So the question becomes how many n-bit masks contain at least one given mask as a subset.

With n <= 20 there are only 2^n masks, so keep one boolean flag per mask and push the flags from subsets to supersets bit by bit (sum over subsets style propagation). Duplicate inputs merge automatically.

Make a boolean array of length 2^n and mark every input value. For each bit step = 1, 2, 4, ..., walk over the blocks and, whenever low in the lower half is marked, mark low + step. After all bits are processed, the number of marked masks is the answer, with no modulus.

explanationEn:
## Approach

Mark the original masks in a boolean array. Propagate over subsets one bit at a time (SOS style): a state in the upper half absorbs the state in the lower half that differs only by the current bit. In the end, each mask's flag says whether it contains at least one original submask; add up the flags.

## Correctness

A result y can be generated from x if and only if every 1 bit of x is also in y, i.e. x is a submask of y. After the first j bits are processed, a flag says whether the mask is reachable from some input when 1s may be added only in those j bits; the next bit propagates sources lacking that bit to states having it, and by induction all positions where adding a 1 is allowed are covered. A boolean union removes duplicates, so the count is exactly the size of the union.

## Complexity

O(n * 2^n + k) time and O(2^n) bytes of space.
